entities.name: Query 768-aa enzyme
observations: A 768-residue soluble protein with calculated mass about 81.8 kDa and pI about 7.58.
Matches reviewed UniProt B0D6H2 over 99% of query length at 86.7% identity; alignment covers B0D6H2 residues approximately 5–770.
The homologous span corresponds to the 3-dehydroquinate synthase and EPSP synthase portions of the pentafunctional AROM polypeptide.
Best functional assignment is a bifunctional prechorismate-pathway enzyme; exact organism and oligomeric state are not established from the sequence alone.

entities.name: B0D6H2 AROM
observations: Reviewed Laccaria bicolor pentafunctional AROM polypeptide; catalyzes five consecutive reactions in prechorismate aromatic-amino-acid biosynthesis.
Annotated domains include 3-dehydroquinate synthase at residues 1–390 and EPSP synthase at residues 403–850.
Curated EC numbers include 4.2.3.4 for 3-dehydroquinate synthase and 2.5.1.19 for EPSP synthase.

entities.name: DAHP to 3-dehydroquinate
observations: 7-phospho-2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-arabino-heptonate is converted to 3-dehydroquinate with release of phosphate.

entities.name: Shikimate-3-phosphate to EPSP
observations: 3-phosphoshikimate reacts with phosphoenolpyruvate to form 5-O-(1-carboxyvinyl)-3-phosphoshikimate and phosphate.

entities.name: Chorismate biosynthesis
observations: The assigned reactions are consecutive steps in the prechorismate/chorismate pathway leading from DAHP toward aromatic amino-acid precursors.
